subject: Google Safe Browsing in the Nulavio Track B build (Firefox 158.0.1 source, not MOZILLA_OFFICIAL)

key.application_restriction: none (desktop browser; the key is embedded in the binary, as in every Gecko/Chromium build)

endpoint_checks.note: HTTP status codes only; requests sent with curl, key passed through a config on stdin
endpoint_checks.clientreport/download (remote download c: 403 SERVICE_DISABLED: safebrowsingdownloadprotection.googleapis.com, not listed in the public API library

findings: The engine requests all lists of a provider in one batch. With stock prefs the unavailable mwb-4b list failed the batch (404), the list manager backed off, and no Google list was ever downloaded although the key was present.
Non-MOZILLA_OFFICIAL builds name the phishing list googpub-phish-proto; with v5 it maps to the same se-4b list as official builds.
Non-MOZILLA_OFFICIAL builds default devtools.chrome.enabled and devtools.debugger.remote-enabled to true.
Newly started content processes are observed without seccomp for about 26-27 ms (3 of 9 processes sampled while opening tabs), then sandboxed; none stayed unsandboxed.

results_after_fix.test_14: phishing and malware lists downloaded; https://testsafebrowsing.appspot.com/s/phishing.html replaced by about:blocked?e=deceptiveBlocked
